# Jaari: Open questions

Last updated: 2026-11-05. Open: **29**.

How to resolve one: decide → write or update an ADR → move the row to *Resolved* with
the ADR link → regenerate. "Leaning" is a suggestion, not a decision.


## A. Blocking soon (Phase 0 to 2)

| ID | Topic | Question | Blocks phase | Leaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| OQ-01 | Channels | Which channels ship in v1 (CLI, web UI, Telegram, Signal, Matrix, Discord, email, iMessage)? | 0 | CLI + one mobile messenger |
| OQ-02 | Owner authentication | How does Jaari verify a message is from the owner? How are new devices paired and revoked? | 0 | Per-channel allowlist + pairing code; unknown senders get nothing |
| OQ-03 | Memory retrieval | grep, SQLite FTS5, embeddings, or hybrid? Which embedding provider (local or API tier)? | 1 | FTS5 first, embeddings as optional layer |
| OQ-04 | Context assembly | Who decides what memory enters each prompt? How are long sessions compacted? | 1 | Deterministic assembler with token budget per section |
| OQ-05 | Scheduler | One job engine for canonicalize, audit, reminders, children: persistence, retries, crash recovery, missed runs during sleep, time zones | 1 | SQLite-backed queue in the daemon |
| OQ-06 | Concurrent memory writes | Lock, single writer queue, or branch-per-task then merge? | 1 | Single writer; others enqueue patches |
